summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the call of an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) to approve the merger of four wholly-owned subsidiaries (Juno, Tijo, Retiro Baixo Energética, and SPE Nova Era Janapu Transmissora). The transaction is a structural simplification: AXIA will succeed all assets, rights, obligations, and contingencies of the merged companies, which will be extinguished. No capital increase, new shares, or withdrawal rights arise because all subsidiaries are wholly held. Completion requires EGM approval and ANEEL authorization. The EGM is scheduled for August 28, 2026. This is a non-russian consolidation that maps to a restructuring event.
